  $cw = IRWorth $k

  return ("IR is full and both stashes are worth more the rest of the way (" + (($occ | ForEach-Object { $_.name + " " + $_.worth }) -join ", ") + " vs " + $cw + " for " + $nm + "): " + $keep + "; " + $act)
}
